Hi all,

Thanks for agreeing to a consolidated office-hours style demo for the December cohort. Instead of three separate 30m sessions, we can do a single 45m consolidated walkthrough followed by a 15m breakout Q&A per company. The goal: show the inference runtime, routing/fallback behavior, and the Optimize recommendations flow that maps to common cost/latency trade-offs.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Dec 29, 10:00–11:00am PST
- Thu Dec 30, 9:00–10:00am PST
- Fri Dec 31, 8:00–9:00am PST

Please reply with your preferred slot (rank 1–2) by EOD Wed so we can lock the calendar and share the pre-demo checklist.

I've attached a short deck (syncboard-deck-v2.pdf) and a one-page agenda. We'll keep the walkthrough focused to the end-to-end inference path, KV/prefix cache demo, and a short run of Redwood Optimize suggestions on a sample prompt set.

Operational notes for Redwood side: cc'd Marissa (ops) and Ben (demo lead). Marissa — can you confirm host/resilience plan and whether we need a technical breakout room with logs access?

Links: HubSpot deal HS-48291 (for scope), drive folder for deck: https://drive.redwood.ai/folders/syncboard-demo-deck

Thanks,
